title: Normalized geometric interfaces for cofinal extension and repetition
statement: For the coefficient systems and compact-support presentations of [def-pur-etale-system-projection-data], let $r:\mathbf N\hookrightarrow\mathbf N$ be an order embedding and let $C_r$ denote the selected tower. On the ordinary unbounded derived category of actual strict systems [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], define $U_r$ by sectionwise restriction. Record the normalized selected left extension $L_r\dashv U_r$ of [lem-pur-system-level-left-extension], ordinary restriction compositors that are identity on selected sections, finite-block repetition at $t(m)=\min\{i:m\le r(i)\}$ [lem-pur-system-block-repetition], and factorization of selected extension as repetition followed by coefficient extension for $D_m=C_{r(t(m))}\to C_m$. A CofinalSupport consists of a normalized projection Theory, these extension, repetition, factorization and compositor data on X and Y, and an isomorphism $h_r:F_C L_r^X\cong L_r^Y F_{C_r}$. Its normalization says that composing $q_{D\to C}$, inverse X factorization, $h_r$, and Y factorization is the coefficient extension of the canonical repetition comparison. Its evaluation at m is the inverse of the single-ring compact-support projection for $C_{r(t(m))}\to C_m$, under the recorded derived-evaluation and factorization isomorphisms. These are exactly the previously existing interfaces, with unchanged definitions and normalization fields.
